meta.scope: Curated public military and joint-use airfield subset for Europe, USA incl. Alaska, and Canada. Simulator use only.
meta.dataSource: airportsdata (MIT licensed), whose maintainers state new contributions are validated against national AIP/equivalent, ARINC, IATA or ch-aviation.

meta.note: Curated public aerodrome subset for simulator planning. Not exhaustive; operational status/availability is not checked. Manual ICAO/distance/elevation remains available. Official publications are referenced for spot-checking, but this bundled dataset is not an operational aeronautical database.
